lyrics: I walked up the marble   steps to find
the man in charge
Looking for the   architect whose shadow
looms so large
They sent me down the corridor,   they pointed
down the hall
But every door I opened   up was just
another wall
I demanded an   audience with the one
who holds the pen   But they just
smiled and passed the buck and sent
me out again
There is no
single villain at the   head of the table
There is no king hiding in   the dark We are fighting
a ghost inside a broken fable
A heavy machine without   a spark
Yeah the hardest truth to finally   bear
Is staring at the empty chair
The empty chair
The banker blames the governor,   the
governor blames the law
The lawyer blames the market   for the fatal,
cracking flaw   It is a
circle of excuses,   a
carousel of blame
Where nobody is responsible, but the outcome
is the same
The gears keep on turning   while the
operators sleep    And the water
keeps on rising   in a river
cold and deep    There is no
single villain at the   head of the table
There is no king hiding in the dark We are fighting
a ghost inside a   broken fable
A heavy machine without a spark
Yeah the hardest truth to finally   bear
Is staring at the empty chair
The empty chair
We wanted a monster with a   name and a face
Somebody to corner, somebody   to chase But the monster
is the system, the monster is the code
And it runs on automatic down a   dead-end road
There is no single villain at the head of the table
There is no king hiding in   the dark We were fighting
a ghost inside a broken fable
A heavy machine without a spark
Now the hardest truth to finally   bear
Is staring at the empty chair
Staring       at the empty
chair!
Nobody is     steering.
And the engine   is running hot.
